name: Legionary (Milites)
notes: Standard Vindolanda garrison soldier. Lorica segmentata, scutum, gladius, pilum.
gm_notes: Generic fort legionary. Use for background soldiers, wall guards, gate watch, and patrol encounters. Not hostile to the party unless ordered. Follows the chain of command. In Session 4 siege: morale check DC 12 WIS if the wall is breached -- failure = -5 ft speed and disadvantage on attacks for 1 minute (shaken, not routing).
